entities.name: Albanian Renaissance
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Albanian Renaissance, a transformative movement in Albania (1830–1912). Emerged from Albanian and Albanian Pashaliks and Autonomy. Catalyzed League of Prizren formed to defend Albanian-inhabited lands and Congress of Monastir standardizes the Albanian alphabet.
